headword: ハイブリッド{勤務|きんむ}
gloss: hybrid work; mixed remote and office work

definitions.gloss: hybrid work arrangement; combining remote work with office work
definitions.explanation: a flexible work style where employees split their time between working from home and working at the office

examples.japanese: うちの{会社|かいしゃ}はハイブリッド{勤務|きんむ}を{導入|どうにゅう}した。
ハイブリッド{勤務|きんむ}で{週|しゅう}3{日|にち}{出社|しゅっしゃ}している。
examples.english: With hybrid work, I go to the office 3 days a week.

examples.japanese: ハイブリッド{勤務|きんむ}のおかげでワークライフバランスが{改善|かいぜん}した。
examples.english: Thanks to hybrid work, my work-life balance has improved.

notes:
MODERN WORK TERM:
ハイブリッド{勤務|きんむ} became widely used after the COVID-19 pandemic as companies adopted flexible work arrangements.

TYPICAL PATTERNS:
- {週|しゅう}2〜3{日|にち}{出社|しゅっしゃ} - going to office 2-3 days per week
- {週|しゅう}2〜3{日|にち}リモート - remote work 2-3 days per week
- {固定|こてい}の{出社日|しゅっしゃび} - fixed office days
- {自由|じゆう}に{選|えら}べる - choose freely

BENEFITS:
- {通勤|つうきん}ストレスの{軽減|けいげん} - reduced commuting stress
- ワークライフバランス{向上|こうじょう} - improved work-life balance
- {対面|たいめん}コミュニケーションも{維持|いじ} - maintains face-to-face communication

RELATED TERMS:
- リモートワーク/テレワーク - remote work
- {在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ} - work from home
- {時差出勤|じさしゅっきん} - staggered hours
- フレックス{制|せい} - flextime
